disclosure.plan: BENCHMARK_PLAN.md §2 disclosure, §3 S-OVL-01, §4 metrics, §5 bias controls

scenario.load: HTTP/1.1, one connection per request, 1 KiB response, closed-loop workers
scenario.overload: 64 workers against 16 connection slots; offered concurrency 4x the cap

disclosure.topology: one host; origin, one proxy at a time and generator are containers on benchv092ovl; no host ports published

overload_policy.eqproxy: when listener maxconn is full, the new connection is closed immediately and rejected_maxconn is incremented
overload_policy.haproxy: frontend maxconn stops accepting; excess connections wait in the kernel accept queue until a slot is free
overload_policy.measurement: EQProxy metrics, HAProxy stats socket, /proc/net/tcp listening-socket rx_queue, cgroup memory

differences: EQProxy refuses at accept; HAProxy queues in the kernel accept queue
one connection per request; keep-alive is not measured
no TLS, rules, rewrites, compression or plugins

calibration.reason: direct origin 3.986x the faster proxy's successful RPS
